description: Thenar muscles missing from MyoHand, added on its bodies. Sites (right-hand body frames; the left hand mirrors z, as myo_sim mirrors the arm) from MUSIC (MIT); architecture (PCSA, optimal fibre length, pennation) from Jacobson et al. 1992 Table I (n = 9 cadaver hands, means); peak force = PCSA x specific tension, with the specific tension MyoHand implies for the thumb muscles Jacobson also measured (below). All values SI except PCSA (cm2) and angles (deg). scales_with / reference_segment tell a personalisation pipeline how to rescale (factors via load_spec(subject_scale=...)). The model itself is the XML written from this table by scripts/generate_thenar_fragments.py: sites in myoarm_r_chain.xml, myoarm_r_thenar_tendon.xml, myoarm_r_thenar_muscle.xml.

music2026.citation: Xu P, Ye Y, Sun S, Ding Y, Schumann E, Liu CK. MUSIC: Learning muscle-driven dexterous hand control. ACM Trans Graph 45(4), 2026 (arXiv:2604.23886).
music2026.code: github.com/xupei0610/music (MIT licence), commit d92783b, right_hand_body.xml / right_hand_tendons.xml / right_hand_muscles.xml
music2026.provenance: MUSIC Appendix A: peak force and optimal fibre length from prior literature (Holzbaur et al. 2005; Del Santo et al. 2007), scaled as the other MyoHand muscles; attachments from anatomical atlases (Rohen et al. 2006; Standring et al. 2005); straight-line paths with via points.

holzbaur2005.citation: Holzbaur KRS, Murray WM, Delp SL. A model of the upper extremity for simulating musculoskeletal surgery and analyzing neuromuscular control. Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840, 2005.
holzbaur2005.note: Origin of the MyoHand thumb kinematics and extrinsic thumb muscles; it has no intrinsic hand muscles, so thumb and index moments were not expected to be accurate.

barry2018.citation: Barry AJ, Murray WM, Kamper DG. Development of a dynamic index finger and thumb model to study impairment. J Biomech 77:206-210, 2018.
barry2018.access: paper closed; OpenSim model on simtk.org/projects/thumbindexdynam (MIT licence, login required)
barry2018.note: Eq. (1): tendon slack length = (L_MT with all crossed joints at 0 - L_fo cos(alpha)) / 1.033.

mcfarland2023.citation: McFarland DC, Binder-Markey BI, Nichols JA, Wohlman SJ, de Bruin M, Murray WM. A musculoskeletal model of the hand and wrist capable of simulating functional tasks. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 70(5):1424-1435, 2023.
mcfarland2023.access: paper open (bioRxiv 10.1101/2021.12.28.474357, PMC10650739); passive parameters in supplement S7 and the ARMS model (simtk.org/projects/arms_hand_model: BSD-3 for non-commercial use only, login required)

jacobson1992.citation: Jacobson MD, Raab R, Fazeli BM, Abrams RA, Botte MJ, Lieber RL. Architectural design of the human intrinsic hand muscles. J Hand Surg Am 17(5):804-809, 1992.
jacobson1992.access: closed; Table I verified visually from the PDF
jacobson1992.note: The text quotes AddP PCSA as 1.10 cm2; Table I gives 1.94 +- 0.39 cm2 (used).

stamenkovic2014.citation: Stamenkovic A, Munro BJ, Peoples GE. Physiological cross-sectional area of the oblique head of the adductor pollicis is greater than its transverse counterpart: implications for functional testing. Muscle Nerve 49(3):405-412, 2014.
stamenkovic2014.access: closed; Table 1 verified visually from the PDF

preferred_replacement: Barry et al. 2018 model paths (MIT) for AdP (two heads) once available.

muscles.name: AdP

alternative.note: Two heads (n = 10, combined PCSA 3.19 cm2); not used because the MUSIC path is a single adductor pollicis.

muscles.path_note: MUSIC's straight path from the third metacarpal gives ~47 mm muscle-tendon excursion over MyoHand's thumb range against 34 mm fibres, so with the architecture length range the normalised fibre length spans ~0.2-1.55 (no active force when short, strong passive force when long). Barry 2018 used two heads and wrapping surfaces; a better path needs their model.

joint_name_note: MUSIC's thumb CMC joints have the same axes as MyoHand's but swapped names: MUSIC cmc_flexion = myo_sim cmc_abduction and vice versa. Sites are body-relative, so the geometry transfers unchanged (lengths and moment arms match MUSIC to 1e-11 m with the names mapped).

specific_tension.derivation: least squares F = sigma x PCSA over MyoHand's OP (180 N), EPB (46.0 N) and APL (116.7 N) with Jacobson 1992 PCSA 1.02, 0.47, 1.93 cm2; per muscle 176.5, 97.9, 60.5 N/cm2, so MyoHand implies no single value and the fitted one is a compromise (forces scale linearly with it).
